verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing documents virtual cards scoped to a single task/session that are automatically invalidated after use, combined with per-authorization spending limits and merchant category/merchant-ID blocking controls — directly matching the single-use, exact-amount, merchant-scoped card story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that auto-invalidation and merchant-lock actually behave as documented in production, and explicit documentation of allowlisting (vs. blocklisting) a single merchant ID.
